Tailored rewards may include Reward Credits, Tier Credits, Casino Bonus Cash, Bonus Spins, Sports Bonus Bets, Profit Boosts and enhanced experiences at Caesars Rewards destinations. articles.summary: FUNNER, CALIF. (Nov. 4, 2026) Harrahs Resort Southern California is pleased to announce the appointment of Ryan Adams to Vice President of Resort Operations. Previously the resorts Director of Food Beverage, Adams will now oversee hotel operations, culinary, retail, spa and guest experience initiatives, driving service excellence and operational growth across the property. Ryan has been an invaluable leader and trusted mentor across Harrahs Resort Southern California since joining us in 2023, said Jill Barrett, Senior Vice President/GM. His deep hospitality acumen paired with a collaborative, people-first approach makes him the perfect choice to lead resort operations and ensure our guests continue to enjoy the standout hospitality that Funner is known for.
